quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fast"? (quick racing cheetah vs slow crawling turtle)
quests.question: Fast
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: A cheetah can run fast, but a snail moves very slowly!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Up"? (climbing high sky vs descending ground levels)
quests.question: Up
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: When you jump up into the air, gravity always pulls you back down!
